newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Last 23,000 Ethiopian refugees to leave Sudan.
newsitem.headline: Last 23,000 Ethiopian refugees to leave Sudan.

text.p: Ethiopia said on Wednesday it expected the last 23,000 Ethiopian refugees in Sudan to be repatriated this year, bringing the total number of Ethiopian returnees to nearly a million since 1991.
The state-run Ethiopian News Agency said the last refugees would return this year in line with an agreement between Sudan, Ethiopia and the U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR).

A total of 967,000 Ethiopian refugees have been repatriated voluntarily from neighbouring countries, including Sudan, since the overthrow of the Marxist military junta of Mengistu Haile Mariam in 1991.
